title: visitor.identified.v1 payload
description: An anonymous visitor was linked to a contact — via signed identity (HMAC, ADR-009), form capture, or agent action. Consumers merge visitor history into the contact (ASSUMPTIONS A4).

contact_created.description: True if the contact record was created by this identification (vs matched to existing).

consent_state.description: Visitor-tracking consent at identification time. Consumers must honor it for analytics processing (§29).
